5.5.impact: Local attacker execute code with MySQL user privileges (root access possible)
5.5.exploit: Manipulate error log file creation with special characters in output to inject shell commands. MySQL then executes them
5.5.prevent: Update MySQL to 5.5.51+ or 5.6.33+ or 5.7.16+. Disable --log-error if not needed
5.5.description_urdu: MySQL ka log file ek backdoor ban sakta hai. Attacker special characters likhta hai jo MySQL command execute karte hain
5.5.how_hacker_exploits: 1) Attacker SQL error trigger karta hai jismein special characters ho 2) MySQL log file mein ye characters likhe jate hain 3) Agar permissions galat ho to shell commands execute ho jate hain
5.5.real_world_impact: Complete server compromise - attacker ko root access mil sakta hai

5.6.issue: Privilege Escalation via temp file handling
5.6.exploit: Race condition in temp file creation allows privilege escalation
5.6.description_urdu: MySQL jo temporary files banata hai unme security hole hai. Local user root ban sakta hai
5.6.how_hacker_exploits: Temporary files karte waqt attacker files ko replace kar deta hai
5.6.real_world_impact: Local user se root privilege escalation

5.7.exploit: Malicious client sends specially crafted capability flags to bypass authentication
5.7.prevent: Update MySQL to 5.7.31+, 8.0.21+. Apply patches from Oracle
5.7.description_urdu: Attacker bina password ke MySQL connect kar sakta hai aur commands execute kar sakta hai
5.7.how_hacker_exploits: 1) Network mein connect karo 2) Galat capability bits bhejo 3) Authentication check bypass ho jaye
5.7.real_world_impact: Pura database leak ya corrupt ho sakta hai

2.4.issue: Path Traversal in mod_alias via trailing slash
2.4.impact: Remote attacker read arbitrary files from server including /etc/passwd
2.4.exploit: Send URL like /cgi-bin/../../../../../../etc/passwd to read files
2.4.prevent: Disable mod_alias and mod_rewrite for CGI directories. Update Apache to 2.4.50+
2.4.description_urdu: Apache ko fool karke server ke private files padh sakte ho. Password files, config, sab kuch leak hota hai
2.4.how_hacker_exploits: 1) URL mein ../ use karke folders ko traverse karo 2) /etc/passwd ya /etc/shadow read karo 3) Source code dekho
2.4.real_world_impact: Server secrets leak - database passwords, API keys, private configs

2.4.exploit: Send oversized authentication header to trigger buffer overflow
2.4.description_urdu: Mod_auth_digest mein buffer overflow vulnerability. Oversized input se crash aur code execute hota hai
2.4.how_hacker_exploits: 1) Long authentication header bhejo 2) Buffer overflow trigger karo 3) Malicious code execute karo

7.2.issue: SSH client information disclosure via roaming buffer
7.2.impact: Client credentials and session data may leak to server
7.2.exploit: Malicious SSH server exploits roaming feature buffer overflow to read client memory
7.2.prevent: Update OpenSSH client to 7.1p2+ or disable roaming (UseRoaming=no)
7.2.description_urdu: SSH client ki memory mein passwords aur private keys ka data leak ho sakta hai
7.2.how_hacker_exploits: 1) Attacker fake SSH server banata hai 2) Client connect karta hai 3) Client ki memory read hoti hai
7.2.real_world_impact: SSH keys, passphrases, previous connection data leak

7.2.impact: Memory corruption allowing arbitrary code execution
7.2.exploit: Roaming mechanism in OpenSSH allows writing to client memory
7.2.description_urdu: SSH client ki memory ko corrupt karke code execute kar sakte ho
7.2.how_hacker_exploits: Roaming buffer overflow se arbitrary writes possible
7.2.real_world_impact: Remote code execution on client machine

vsftpd.impact: Unauthenticated attacker execute arbitrary shell commands
vsftpd.exploit: Send username containing :) characters which triggers command execution
vsftpd.prevent: Upgrade vsftpd to version 3.0.0 or newer. Better: Remove FTP, use SFTP
vsftpd.description_urdu: vsftpd 2.3.4 mein special characters username se code execute hota hai. Koi bhi without login access paata hai
vsftpd.how_hacker_exploits: 1) FTP server ko port 21 par connect karo 2) Username mein ':)' dalo 3) Shell command execute ho jaye
vsftpd.real_world_impact: Complete server compromise without any password

legacy.issue: Plain Text Protocol - All data transmitted unencrypted
legacy.impact: Passwords, commands, and sensitive data visible on network
legacy.exploit: Network packet sniffing (TCPDump, Wireshark) to capture everything
legacy.prevent: DO NOT USE TELNET. Replace with SSH completely.
legacy.description_urdu: TELNET bilkul open network par chalti hai. Koi bhi network se sab kuch dekh sakta hai - passwords, commands, sab
legacy.how_hacker_exploits: 1) Same network mein baithkar packet sniffer chala do 2) Pura TELNET traffic dikhai dega 3) Passwords aur commands padhna
legacy.real_world_impact: Immediate credential compromise and server takeover

1.0.impact: Remote Code Execution affecting millions of Windows systems
1.0.exploit: Send specially crafted SMB packets that overflow memory buffers in SMBv1
1.0.prevent: Disable SMBv1 completely. Update Windows with MS17-010 patch. Enable Windows Firewall
1.0.description_urdu: EternalBlue sabse famous ransomware attack tha. 150+ countries mein 200,000 computers hack hua ek rate
1.0.how_hacker_exploits: 1) Malformed SMB request bhejo 2) Buffer overflow trigger karo 3) Shell commands execute karo 4) Ransomware install karo
1.0.real_world_impact: WannaCry ne hospitals mein surgeries cancel karni padi the, billions loss hua

windows.issue: BlueKeep - Remote Desktop Protocol RCE without authentication
windows.impact: Remote attacker execute arbitrary code without login credentials
windows.exploit: Send specially crafted RDP request that triggers memory corruption. No authentication needed
windows.prevent: Apply Windows security patches MS19-011 immediately. Disable RDP if not needed
windows.description_urdu: BlueKeep se attacker password ke bina server pe code execute kar sakta hai. Ransomware ka target
windows.how_hacker_exploits: 1) RDP port 3389 ko scan karo 2) Malformed RDP packet bhejo 3) Memory corruption trigger karo 4) Code execute karo
windows.real_world_impact: Millions of Windows servers were vulnerable. Botnets, ransomware targets

4.0.impact: Unauthorized access to all Redis data and operations
4.0.exploit: Connect to port 6379 and execute any Redis command (GET, SET, FLUSHALL, etc)
4.0.prevent: Enable requirepass with strong password. Firewall Redis behind network. Use AUTH
4.0.description_urdu: Redis default mein koi password nahi hota! Internet par expose karo to kabhi bhi koi bhi data steal ya delete kar sakta hai
4.0.how_hacker_exploits: 1) Port 6379 ko scan karo 2) Bina password connect karo 3) KEYS * command se sab data dekho 4) FLUSHALL se sab delete karo
4.0.real_world_impact: RAKHENA-WIPER ransomware ne Redis servers ko target kiya aur millions data wipe kar diya

3.0.impact: Authentication bypass on improperly configured instances
3.0.exploit: Use $where operator in queries to execute arbitrary JavaScript, bypassing auth
3.0.prevent: Update MongoDB to 3.6+, 4.0+, 4.2+. Disable JavaScript execution if not needed
3.0.description_urdu: MongoDB mein $where operator se JavaScript execute ho sakta hai aur auth bypass possible hai
3.0.how_hacker_exploits: 1) MongoDB se connect karo 2) $where operator use karo 3) JavaScript code execute karo 4) Authentication bypass

3.0.impact: Unauthenticated access to entire database when exposed
3.0.exploit: Connect to port 27017 without credentials and read/modify/delete all data
3.0.prevent: Enable authentication in MongoDB. Set requireAuth=true. Firewall port 27017
3.0.description_urdu: MongoDB pehle default mein authentication disable rehta tha! Millions databases publicly exposed the. Patient records, emails, passwords - sabkuch
3.0.how_hacker_exploits: 1) 27017 port scan 2) Authentication prompt nahi hota 3) Full database access 4) Data steal karo
3.0.real_world_impact: 27 million records of Chinese hospital exposed. Uber data hack. Millions healthcare records leaked

9.5.impact: Attacker can read sensitive data from database
9.5.exploit: Use SQL_ASCII encoding to bypass certain access controls
9.5.prevent: Use UTF8 encoding. Restrict database access via firewall. Update PostgreSQL
9.5.description_urdu: PostgreSQL mein encoding issues se private data read ho sakta hai
9.5.how_hacker_exploits: Special encoding use karke access controls bypass karo
9.5.real_world_impact: Database records accessible without proper authorization

1.6.issue: Admin Party Mode by Default - No Authentication
1.6.impact: Everyone has admin privileges - complete database control possible
1.6.exploit: Connect to CouchDB admin panel and create databases, read all data, delete everything
1.6.prevent: Disable admin party mode. Create admin user. Enable authentication. Update CouchDB
1.6.description_urdu: CouchDB ka admin party mode likha hi dangerous hai. Koi bhi admin ban sakta hai aur pura database delete kar sakta hai
1.6.how_hacker_exploits: 1) CouchDB port 5984 ko hit karo 2) Admin API access karo 3) Database delete karo 4) Ransomware scenario
1.6.real_world_impact: Complete data loss. Databases corrupted or stolen
